text: A Song of Ascents. In my trouble I cried out to ADONAI, and He answered me.
ADONAI, deliver my soul from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
What can be given to you, and what more can be done to you, O deceitful tongue? —
sharp arrows of the mighty, with burning coals of a broom tree!
Woe to me, for I sojourn in Meshech, for I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
My soul has too long dwelt with those who hate shalom.
I am for shalom and thus I speak, but they are for war!
